question: GARBH-INi-DRISHTI, which was launched at Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI) in February 2025, provides access to an unprecedented wealth of clinical data, images and biospecimens collected from over 12,000 _______.

options.text: patients suffering from haemophilia and other blood diseases
pregnant women, newborns and postpartum mothers

solution:
p data-end="57" data-start="0">The correct answer is __**pregnant women, newborns and postpartum mothers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **GARBH-INi-DRISHTI** platform was launched in **February 2025** at the **Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI)** located in **Faridabad**, Haryana.
 
• The platform provides access to a comprehensive database containing clinical data, medical images, and biospecimens from over **12,000** participants, specifically **pregnant women**, **newborns**, and **postpartum mothers**. ***Hence, the correct answer is pregnant women, newborns and postpartum mothers.***
 
• The initiative is part of the **GARBH-Ini** (Interdisciplinary Group for Advanced Research on Birth Outcomes—DBT India Initiative) program, which is a flagship project of the **Department of Biotechnology (DBT)**.
